reasons.point-the-tip-red: Combines +3 power with an aim counter, enabling Bolt'n' Shot while unlocking the aim bonuses of arrows loaded by Death Dealer or Call in the Big Guns.
reasons.whisper-of-the-oracle-red: Opt 4 helps put the right arrow on top for Azalea, improving access to dominate and Crow's Nest aim counters.
reasons.memorial-ground-red: Returns an eligible spent arrow to the top of your deck so Azalea can load it with dominate and Crow's Nest can add an aim counter.
reasons.fletch-a-red-tail-red: Its +4 power enables Bolt'n' Shot and Bolt'n Boots, while an aim counter adds a defense penalty that helps your stacked hit effects connect.
reasons.over-flex-red: Adds +4 power to enable your Bolt'n effects, while reload can supply an arsenal card for Azalea to exchange.
reasons.seek-horizon-red: Putting an arrow from hand on top sets up a guaranteed arrow for Azalea, and the resulting go again lets you continue into the dominated attack.
reasons.silver-the-tip-red: Selects an arrow from the top four cards and loads it face-up from your deck, triggering Crow's Nest and your arrows' arsenal-entry abilities.
reasons.increase-the-tension-red: Adds +3 power and closes off defense reactions from hand, complementing Release the Tension's restriction on arsenal reactions.
reasons.monkey-powder-red: Its +1 power enables Bolt'n' Shot and Bolt'n Boots, while drawing a card replenishes fuel for pumps or additional arrows.
reasons.widowmaker-red: Azalea's dominate makes its fewer-than-two-defenders bonus harder to avoid, while its defense-reaction ban strengthens your stacked arrow buffs.
